svg.title: contentworker reference architecture, one customer deployment
svg.desc: Three kinds of client reach one customer deployment. Admin users sign in at the web worker ①, which forwards their requests to the api worker over the API service binding with a signed x-cw-principal header ②. API and MCP agents call the api directly with bearer tokens ③. The api commits each write to the primary database as one unit of work that includes an outbox row ④, then relays the outbox onto the contentworker-events queue in waitUntil ⑤. The engine worker, which has no public route, consumes those events and runs webhooks, search and vector indexing and live fan-out ⑥, and enqueues purge tags that the delivery and media workers drain against their own caches ⑦. Public delivery consumers call the delivery gateway with CDA or CPA keys; it authenticates every request from a principal cached in the key-value store ⑧ and forwards a canonical URL keyed by visibility profile to the cached Delivery entrypoint, which reads a database read replica only on a miss ⑨. The engine alone writes the media gate in the key-value store ⑩. The media gateway checks each published file URL's token and forwards it to the cached Media entrypoint, which reads the gate, the bytes from object storage and resized variants from edge image transforms ⑪. Uploads land in object storage through the api's signed PUT; its object-create notification feeds the asset-events queue, and the engine starts one AssetIngestWorkflow per file version, which calls edge inference through the AI gateway and writes embeddings to the vector index ⑫. The api and delivery workers reach the engine's stateful objects and durable workflows through script_name bindings ⑬.
